nodes.description: address public owner of Ownable, set to msg.sender in the constructor and changed by transferOwnership.
string public name of the ERC20 token, set in the ERC20Token constructor.
string public symbol of the ERC20 token, set in the ERC20Token constructor.
uint256 public decimals of the ERC20 token, set in the ERC20Token constructor.
uint256 public totalSupply, minted in the ERC20Token constructor and reduced by burn.
mapping(address=>uint256) public balanceOf holding token balances.
nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) public allowance for delegated transfers.
Ownable() constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner, changes owner state variable.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure, checked multiplication with assert.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure, plain division with no zero check.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure, asserts b <= a before subtraction.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure, asserts c >= a before returning.
ERC20Token(string,string,uint256,uint256) constructor minting totalSupply to msg.sender.
_transfer(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) internal core balance-moving routine.
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public, moves msg.sender balance via _transfer.
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint256 _value) public, spends allowance then calls _transfer.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public, writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Omnic(string,string,uint256,uint256) constructor forwarding to ERC20Token constructor.
payable fallback function that immediately reverts, rejecting plain ether transfers.
burn(uint256 _value) onlyOwner public, destroys owner tokens and reduces totalSupply.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller address used for ownership, minting and authorization.
Unchecked multiplication _totalSupply * 10 ** decimals in the ERC20Token constructor (pre-0.8 arithmetic).
Fallback function performs an unconditional revert, recording an unsafe rejection path for unexpected calls.
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
uint256 a parameter of SafeMath.mul.
uint256 b parameter of SafeMath.mul.
uint256 a parameter of SafeMath.div.
uint256 b parameter of SafeMath.div (division by zero risk).
uint256 a parameter of SafeMath.sub.
uint256 b parameter of SafeMath.sub.
uint256 a parameter of SafeMath.add.
uint256 b parameter of SafeMath.add.
string _name parameter of the ERC20Token constructor.
string _symbol parameter of the ERC20Token constructor.
uint256 _decimals parameter of the ERC20Token constructor, exponent of the unchecked 10**decimals.
uint256 _totalSupply parameter of the ERC20Token constructor, operand of the unchecked multiplication.
address _from parameter of the internal _transfer.
address _to parameter of the internal _transfer.
uint256 _value parameter of the internal _transfer.
address _to parameter of the public transfer function.
uint256 _value parameter of the public transfer function.
address _from parameter of transferFrom.
address _to parameter of transferFrom.
uint256 _value parameter of transferFrom, checked against allowance.
address _spender parameter of approve.
uint256 _value parameter of approve.
string name parameter of the Omnic constructor.
string symbol parameter of the Omnic constructor.
uint256 decimals parameter of the Omnic constructor.
uint256 totalSupply parameter of the Omnic constructor.
uint256 _value parameter of burn, amount destroyed from the owner balance.
uint256 c local result of multiplication in SafeMath.mul.
uint256 c local result of division in SafeMath.div.
uint256 c local result of addition in SafeMath.add.
uint256 previousBalances snapshot of combined balances in _transfer used by the final assert.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the caller controls the privileged owner role.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner, gating transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier gates burn, so msg.sender must equal owner.
Constructor mints the whole supply to the deploying msg.sender.
balanceOf[msg.sender] is written in the ERC20Token constructor.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from account of _transfer.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender when checking and decrementing allowance.
approve writes the allowance mapping keyed by msg.sender.
Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership mutates the owner state variable after the onlyOwner check.
Constructor computes the unchecked product _totalSupply * 10 ** decimals.
The unchecked multiplication result is stored into totalSupply, allowing overflow.
Constructor assigns the minted amount to totalSupply.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
transfer delegates the balance mutation to the internal _transfer function.
transferFrom delegates the balance mutation to the internal _transfer function.
_transfer subtracts from and adds to the balanceOf mapping.
burn reduces balanceOf[msg.sender] by the burned value.
burn decrements totalSupply through SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
approve overwrites the allowance entry for the spender.
Omnic constructor invokes the inherited ERC20Token constructor with its arguments.
Omnic inherits and runs the Ownable constructor through the inheritance chain.
Fallback function executes an unconditional revert for unexpected calldata.
Constructor parameter _totalSupply is an operand of the unchecked multiplication.
Constructor parameter _decimals is the exponent of 10 ** decimals in the unchecked expression.
newOwner parameter flows into the owner state variable assignment.
Parameter a is used as operand in SafeMath.mul.
Parameter b is used as operand in SafeMath.mul.
Parameter a is used as dividend in SafeMath.div.
Parameter b is used as divisor in SafeMath.div.
Parameter a is minuend in SafeMath.sub.
Parameter b is subtrahend in SafeMath.sub.
Parameter a is first addend in SafeMath.add.
Parameter b is second addend in SafeMath.add.
_name parameter is stored into the name state variable.
_symbol parameter is stored into the symbol state variable.
_decimals parameter is stored into the decimals state variable.
_totalSupply parameter drives the minted supply computation.
_from parameter selects the debited balance entry in _transfer.
_to parameter selects the credited balance entry in _transfer.
_value parameter is the amount moved in _transfer.
_to parameter forwarded to _transfer from the public transfer function.
_value parameter forwarded to _transfer from the public transfer function.
_from parameter used for the allowance lookup in transferFrom.
_to parameter forwarded to _transfer from transferFrom.
_value parameter checked against and subtracted from allowance in transferFrom.
_spender parameter becomes the allowance mapping key in approve.
_value parameter becomes the stored allowance amount in approve.
name parameter forwarded to the ERC20Token constructor.
symbol parameter forwarded to the ERC20Token constructor.
decimals parameter forwarded to the ERC20Token constructor.
totalSupply parameter forwarded to the ERC20Token constructor.
_value parameter is the amount burned from the owner balance.
Local c holds the product that is validated by assert(c / a == b).
Local c holds the division result returned from SafeMath.div.
Local c holds the sum validated by assert(c >= a) in SafeMath.add.
previousBalances snapshot is compared with the post-transfer balance sum in the final assert.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only used to set the owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
a is an operand used solely inside SafeMath.mul.
b is an operand used solely inside SafeMath.mul.
a is the dividend used solely inside SafeMath.div.
b is the divisor used solely inside SafeMath.div.
a is the minuend used solely inside SafeMath.sub.
b is the subtrahend used solely inside SafeMath.sub.
a is an addend used solely inside SafeMath.add.
b is an addend used solely inside SafeMath.add.
_name is stored directly into name by the constructor.
_symbol is stored directly into symbol by the constructor.
_decimals is stored into decimals and used in the constructor's exponentiation.
_totalSupply is the operand of the unchecked multiplication that defines totalSupply.
_from only indexes balanceOf inside the internal _transfer.
_to only indexes balanceOf inside the internal _transfer.
_value is the amount applied to balances inside _transfer.
_to is forwarded from the public transfer entry point.
_value is forwarded from the public transfer entry point.
_from is used for the allowance lookup inside transferFrom.
_to is forwarded by transferFrom.
_value is validated and subtracted from allowance inside transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance key inside approve.
_value is the allowance amount stored inside approve.
name is only passed through the Omnic constructor to ERC20Token.
symbol is only passed through the Omnic constructor to ERC20Token.
decimals is only passed through the Omnic constructor to ERC20Token.
totalSupply is only passed through the Omnic constructor to ERC20Token.
_value is the burned amount used inside burn.
c is a temporary result local to SafeMath.mul.
c is a temporary result local to SafeMath.div.
c is a temporary result local to SafeMath.add.
previousBalances is a temporary conservation-check value local to _transfer.
